name: api-rate-limit-recovery
intent: Implement protocol-aware retry behavior that respects server guidance, preserves idempotency, and terminates under a declared attempt and time budget.
successCondition: Stop when bounded success, cancellation, exhaustion, malformed guidance, and duplicate-prevention cases pass locally.
operations: classify retryable responses and server delay hints
bind attempts to idempotency and cancellation
verify success exhaustion malformed-hint and concurrency cases
preconditions: retry semantics are current and documented
the operation's idempotency class is known
positiveTriggers: Add bounded recovery for documented rate-limit responses.
Verify retry delay, idempotency, jitter, and terminal failure behavior.
negativeTriggers: Circumvent a provider quota or access policy.
Retry non-idempotent work without a deduplication contract.
failureModes: stop at the attempt or elapsed-time ceiling
surface malformed delay guidance instead of retrying indefinitely
exclusions: does not authorize network calls or credential use
terminationConditions: Stop when bounded success, cancellation, exhaustion, malformed guidance, and duplicate-prevention cases pass locally.

measurableImprovement.baseline: the current eternities-daedalus route without this exact operational mechanism
measurableImprovement.threshold: all critical cases pass with exact evidence and no authority or effect regression
